title: The Great Data Debate
summary: My last job was I ran marketing for a company, and I really went deep into growth marketing. thesis: The episode debates the future of the modern data stack, specifically focusing on whether data lakes will eventually consume all data or if SQL-based data warehouses will subsume them. While one expert argues that data lakes are optimized for unstructured data and operational AI, another contends that relational SQL models will win over time by evolving to support complex data like images and videos, though full processing capabilities may require procedural logic like Python for the next decade.
